verdict.rationale: Docs confirm creating subscriptions via the Subscriptions API, updating them with proration previews, and monitoring status transitions (including cancellation) via webhooks, showing solid API-first lifecycle support. However, no citation explicitly documents 'pause' or 'cancel' API calls/parameters, and one doc even frames invoice creation as dashboard-first with 'no code required,' leaving some lifecycle steps under-evidenced for a code-only workflow. Missing for 10: explicit API reference/example for pausing subscriptions, explicit cancel-subscription API example, and independent hands-on confirmation of a fully dashboard-free lifecycle.
